title: THE WU JEN - the oriental wizard: the Intelligence doctrine with the spell-learning mechanics, the two ki powers, the elemental mastery, the pupils, the taboo ladder, Tables 31, 32 and 33
audit_comment: OA round thirteen (capture pp. 47-51): the wu jen - the minima, the spell-learning doctrine, the ki powers, the elemental mastery and the taboo ladder

banner.title: THE WU JEN, printed capture pp. 47-51 - the OA wu jen round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 47-51 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). Three cells settled against the 2018 print BEFORE pinning, per the settling doctrine: the T31 row-2 bound (the capture lost the comma - 4,000); the T33 row-5 first-spell cell (the capture prints 4, the 2018 prints 3, the ladder-consistent reading stands); the T33 row-22 ninth-spell cell (the capture prints 2, the 2018 prints 1, the ladder-consistent reading stands). The T32 All maximum pins as the -1 code; the T33 dashes pin as zeros. OCR normalization: konobokuru reads as korobokuru; in hit, spell book reads as in his spell book; cloud/adder reads as cloud ladder (prose only)
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 56 closed, 179 open - the wu jen boxes with Tables 31, 32 and 33 flip (census 548 -> 549); NEXT - R627: the Yakuza, capture pp. 51-54, Tables 34 and 35, prefix dgn (verify free), audit "R627 OA yakuza audit", include after rules/oawujen.h

bools.name: dgmWuJenNeverLawful
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 48): wu jen cannot be lawful

bools.name: dgmWuJenRaces
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 48): human, korobokuru and hengeyokai can be wu jen

bools.name: dgmWuJenMagicUserTables
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 48): the magic-user combat and saving throw tables

bools.name: dgmWuJenNoArmor
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 48): cannot wear armor or use shields, limited to the Table 13 weapons

bools.name: dgmWuJenMeditates
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): learns to meditate like a shukenja as part of the mental regimen

bools.name: dgmWuJenUnderstandKnowMemorize
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): understanding, knowing and remembering are three different things - only study of the spell book lets him cast from memory

bools.name: dgmWuJenIntLossRecheck
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): a lasting Intelligence loss forces a recheck of every understood spell against the new maximum; a gain allows new learning

bools.name: dgmWuJenScrollDestroyed
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): new spells come from a teacher, another wu jen book or a scroll - the scroll is destroyed in learning

bools.name: dgmWuJenMasterLostOnNewLevel
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): the element mastery is lost when a higher spell level becomes castable until all its spells are learned

bools.name: dgmWuJenStrongholdWithLieutenant
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 50): no fighting men attracted - he hires them and must employ a lieutenant to command them

bools.name: dgmWuJenTenguOniLanguage
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 51): wu jen speak the language of tengu and oni

bools.name: dgmWuJenNoFamily
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 51): no Table 38 roll, no family bonuses or penalties

bools.name: dgmWuJenLightHonor
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 51): integrity without the honor codes - bonuses and penalties of honor are much smaller

bools.name: dgmWuJenTabooConsequences
bools.comment: Wu jen prose (capture p. 51): violating a taboo brings loss of spells, illness or other evil events; the DM may add similar taboos

tables.name: dgmT31Grid
tables.comment: the Table 31 wu jen advancement grid (capture pp. 47-48)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 2,000 at 1st to 800,000 at 11th - the row-2 bound OCR-mangled in the capture (4000 without the comma) and settled against the 2018 print (capture pp. 47-48).
the accumulated d4 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture pp. 47-48).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 1 hp per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 1, 2 (capture pp. 47-48).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 31 grid: the xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture pp. 47-48)

tables.name: dgmT32Grid
tables.comment: the Table 32 wu jen Intelligence adjustments grid (capture p. 48)
col_comments: the chance to know each listed spell column: 35 percent at Int 9 climbing 10 per tier to 95 at 19 or more (capture p. 48).
the minimum number of spells per level column: 4 at Int 9 to 10 at 19 or more (capture p. 48).
the maximum number of spells per level column: 6 at Int 9 to 18 at Int 18, then the printed All at 19 or more pinned as the -1 code (capture p. 48).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 32 grid: the know chance with the spell minima and maxima (capture p. 48)

tables.name: dgmT33Grid
tables.comment: the Table 33 wu jen spells usable by level grid (capture p. 49)
col_comments: the 1st-level spells column: 1 at 1st to 9 at 28th - the row-5 cell (level 5) is contested, the capture prints 4 and the 2018 print 3; the 2018 ladder-consistent reading stands (capture p. 49).
the 2nd-level spells column: none until 3rd, then 1 to 9 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 3rd-level spells column: none until 5th, then 1 to 8 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 4th-level spells column: none until 7th, then 1 to 8 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 5th-level spells column: none until 9th, then 1 to 7 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 6th-level spells column: none until 11th, then 1 to 7 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 7th-level spells column: none until 13th, then 1 to 6 at 29th (capture p. 49).
the 8th-level spells column: none until 17th, then 1 to 5 at 29th (capture p. 49).

the 9th-level spells column: none until 21st, then 1 to 4 at 29th - the row-22 cell (level 22) is contested, the capture prints 2 and the 2018 print 1; the 2018 ladder-consistent reading stands (capture p. 49).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 33 grid: the nine spell-level columns, levels 1-29 (capture p. 49)
